# Electronom Catalog and Technical Base

Electronom is a premium Ukrainian electrical engineering e-commerce platform offering modern circuit breakers, lighting, cables, batteries, and other equipment.

## Core Categories

- **[Circuit Breakers (Автоматичні вимикачі)](https://electronom.com.ua/uk/catalog/avtomatychni-vymykachi)**
  - Subcategories: Single-pole, two-pole, three-pole, differential breakers.
  - Featured Brands: Hager, ABB, Schneider Electric, Eaton.
- **[Sockets & Switches (Розетки та вимикачі)](https://electronom.com.ua/uk/catalog/rozetky-ta-vymykachi)**
  - Featured Brands: Legrand, Schneider Electric, Werkel.
- **[Cables & Wires (Кабель та провід)](https://electronom.com.ua/uk/catalog/kabel-ta-provid)**
  - Types: VVGng, VVGng-LS, PVS.
- **[LED Lighting (Освітлення LED)](https://electronom.com.ua/uk/catalog/osvitlennya-led)**
  - Types: LED panels, lamps, LED strips.
- **[Batteries (Акумулятори)](https://electronom.com.ua/uk/catalog/akumulyatory)**
  - Technologies: AGM, GEL, LiFePO4 (high cycle endurance).

## Support & Guides

- **[Knowledge Hub & Blog](https://electronom.com.ua/uk/blog)**: Professional selection guides (breaker ratings, cable sizing tables, UPS backup battery sizing).
- **[Delivery & Payment](https://electronom.com.ua/uk/delivery)**: Nationwide shipping in Ukraine via Nova Poshta.
